rules.adjacency: Orthogonal 4-neighbour on (x,y) grid; a node is selectable iff a neighbour is the start node or already selected. Deselecting must not orphan selected nodes. Source: aion2t.com planner JS logic (x() and removal BFS). Not confirmed in-game.
rules.start_node: Centre of each grid; free, cost 0, not selectable.

reset_cost.confidence: low: one-line patch note, Global unverified

rules.skill_level_note: Daevanion adds up to +4 skill levels per prior notes; per-board grant above is sum of skill nodes.

point_sources.detail: 2 Daevanion Crystals per clear; 61 per faction map = 122 points per full clear

global_vs_korea.note: aion2t.com Ranger API returns 5 boards (Nezekan, Zikel, Vaizel, Triniel, Azphel), same as Sorcerer; metaroad shows the same 5. couga54 guide (checked 2026-10-03) states there is no Ariel board on global and Azphel has no skill nodes (PvP stats only). aion2t footer claims 8 boards per class; unresolved.
global_vs_korea.data_region: aion2t.com says data from official NCSOFT API; couga54 says boards are the real global boards from questlog.gg client data. Global launch 2026-10-05 not yet verified in-game.
